IRCTC and Quality Council Partner for Food Safety

The Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC) has partnered with the Quality Council of India to enhance food safety and hygiene standards across railway catering units. This collaboration aims to implement stricter checks for food served to passengers on trains and at stations.
